passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.1
passages.text: Hanc tibi Priamides mitto, Ledaea, salutem,

passages.text: Ille quidem lateat malim, dum tempora dentur

passages.text: Laetitiae mixtos non habitura metus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.11
passages.text: Parce, precor, fasso, nec vultu cetera duro

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.25

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.223
passages.text: Rumpor et invidia — quid enim non omnia narrem? —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.224
passages.text: Membra superiecta cum tua veste fovet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.225
passages.text: Oscula cum vero coram non dura daretis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.226
passages.text: Ante oculos posui pocula sumpta meos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.227
passages.text: Lumina demitto cum te tenet artius ille,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.228
passages.text: Crescit et invito lentus in ore cibus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.229
passages.text: Saepe dedi gemitus; et te — lasciva! — notavi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.230
passages.text: In gemitu risum non tenuisse meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.231
passages.text: Saepe mero volui flammam compescere, at illa

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.232
passages.text: Crevit, et ebrietas ignis in igne fuit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.233
passages.text: Multaque ne videam, versa cervice recumbo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.234
passages.text: Sed revocas oculos protinus ipsa meos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.235
passages.text: Quid faciam, dubito; dolor est meus illa videre,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.236
passages.text: Sed dolor a facie maior abesse tua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.237
passages.text: Qua licet et possum, luctor celare furorem;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.238
passages.text: Sed tamen apparet dissimulatus amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.239
passages.text: Nec tibi verba damus; sentis mea vulnera, sentis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.240
passages.text: Atque utinam soli sint ea nota tibi!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.241
passages.text: A, quotiens lacrimis venientibus ora reflexi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.242
passages.text: Ne causam fletus quaereret ille mei!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.243
passages.text: A, quotiens aliquem narravi potus amorem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.244
passages.text: Ad vulnus referens singula verba meum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.245
passages.text: Indiciumque mei ficto sub nomine feci!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.246
passages.text: Ille ego, si nescis, verus amator eram.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.247
passages.text: Quin etiam, ut possem verbis petulantius uti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.248
passages.text: Non semel ebrietas est simulata mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.249
passages.text: Prodita sunt, memini, tunica tua pectora laxa

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.250
passages.text: Atque oculis aditum nuda dedere meis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.251
passages.text: Pectora vel puris nivibus vel lacte tuamve

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.252
passages.text: Complexo matrem candidiora Iove.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.253
passages.text: Dum stupeo visis — nam pocula forte tenebam —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.254
passages.text: Tortilis a digitis excidit ansa meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.255
passages.text: Oscula si natae dederas, ego protinus illa

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.256
passages.text: Hermiones tenero laetus ab ore tuli.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.257
passages.text: Et modo cantabam veteres resupinus amores,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.258
passages.text: Et modo per nutum signa tegenda dabam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.259
passages.text: Et comitum primas, Clymenen Aethramque, tuarum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.260
passages.text: Ausus sum blandis nuper adire sonis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.261
passages.text: Quae mihi non aliud, quam formidare, locutae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.262
passages.text: Orantis medias deseruere preces.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.263
passages.text: Di facerent, pretium magni certaminis esses,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.264
passages.text: Teque suo posset victor habere toro! —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.265
passages.text: Ut tulit Hippomenes Schoeneida praemia cursus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.266
passages.text: Venit ut in Phrygios Hippodamia sinus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.267
passages.text: Ut ferus Alcides Acheloia cornua fregit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.268
passages.text: Dum petit amplexus, Deianira, tuos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.269
passages.text: Nostra per has leges audacia fortiter isset,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.270
passages.text: Teque mei scires esse laboris opus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.271
passages.text: Nunc mihi nil superest nisi te, formosa, precari,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.272
passages.text: Amplectique tuos, si patiare, pedes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.273
passages.text: O decus, o praesens geminorum gloria fratrum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.274
passages.text: O Iove digna viro, ni Iove nata fores,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.275
passages.text: Aut ego Sigeos repetam te coniuge portus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.276
passages.text: Aut hic Taenaria contegar exul humo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.277
passages.text: Non mea sunt summa leviter destricta sagitta

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.278
passages.text: Pectora; descendit vulnus ad ossa meum!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.279
passages.text: Hoc mihi — nam repeto — fore, ut a caeleste sagitta

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.280
passages.text: Figar, erat verax vaticinata soror.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.281
passages.text: Parce datum fatis, Helene, contemnere amorem —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.282
passages.text: Sic habeas faciles in tua vota deos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.283
passages.text: Multa quidem subeunt; sed coram ut plura loquamur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.284
passages.text: Excipe me lecto nocte silente tuo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.285
passages.text: An pudet et metuis Venerem temerare maritam

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.286
passages.text: Castaque legitimi fallere iura tori?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.287
passages.text: A, nimium simplex Helene, ne rustica dicam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.288
passages.text: Hanc faciem culpa posse carere putas?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.289
passages.text: Aut faciem mutes aut sis non dura, necesse est;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.290
passages.text: Lis est cum forma magna pudicitiae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.291
passages.text: Iuppiter his gaudet, gaudet Venus aurea furtis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.292
passages.text: Haec tibi nempe patrem furta dedere Iovem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.293
passages.text: Vix fieri, si sunt vires in semine morum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.294
passages.text: Et Iovis et Ledae filia casta potest.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.295
passages.text: Casta tamen tum sis, cum te mea Troia tenebit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.296
passages.text: Et tua sim, quaeso, crimina solus ego.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.297
passages.text: Nunc ea peccemus quae corriget hora iugalis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.298
passages.text: Si modo promisit non mihi vana Venus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.299
passages.text: Ipse tibi hoc suadet rebus, non voce, maritus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.300
passages.text: Neve sui furtis hospitis obstet, abest.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.301
passages.text: Non habuit tempus, quo Cresia regna videret,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.302
passages.text: Aptius — o mira calliditate virum!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.303
passages.text: 'Res, et ut Idaei mando tibi,' dixit iturus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.304
passages.text: 'Curam pro nobis hospitis, uxor, agas.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.305
passages.text: Neclegis absentis, testor, mandata mariti!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.306
passages.text: Cura tibi non est hospitis ulla tui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.307
passages.text: Huncine tu speras, hominem sine pectore, dotes

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.308
passages.text: Posse satis formae, Tyndari, nosse tuae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.309
passages.text: Falleris — ignorat; nec, si bona magna putaret,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.310
passages.text: Quae tenet, externo crederet illa viro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.311
passages.text: Ut te nec mea vox nec te meus incitet ardor,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.312
passages.text: Cogimur ipsius commoditate frui —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.313
passages.text: Aut erimus stulti, sic ut superemus et ipsum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.314
passages.text: Si tam securum tempus abibit iners.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.315
passages.text: Paene suis ad te manibus deducit amantem;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.316
passages.text: Utere mandantis simplicitate viri!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.317
passages.text: Sola iaces viduo tam longa nocte cubili;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.318
passages.text: In viduo iaceo solus et ipse toro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.319
passages.text: Te mihi meque tibi communia gaudia iungant;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.320
passages.text: Candidior medio nox erit illa die.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.321
passages.text: Tunc ego iurabo quaevis tibi numina meque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.322
passages.text: Adstringam verbis in sacra vestra meis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.323
passages.text: Tunc ego, si non est fallax fiducia nostri,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.324
passages.text: Efficiam praesens, ut mea regna petas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.325
passages.text: Si pudet et metuis ne me videare secuta,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.326
passages.text: Ipse reus sine te criminis huius ero;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.327
passages.text: Nam sequar Aegidae factum fratrumque tuorum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.328
passages.text: Exemplo tangi non propiore potes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.329
passages.text: Te rapuit Theseus, geminas Leucippidas illi;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.330
passages.text: Quartus in exemplis adnumerabor ego.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.331
passages.text: Troica classis adest armis instructa virisque;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.332
passages.text: Iam facient celeres remus et aura vias.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.333
passages.text: Ibis Dardanias ingens regina per urbes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.334
passages.text: Teque novam credet vulgus adesse deam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.335
passages.text: Quaque feres gressus, adolebunt cinnama flammae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.336
passages.text: Caesaque sanguineam victima planget humum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.337
passages.text: Dona pater fratresque et cum genetrice sorores

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.338
passages.text: Iliadesque omnes totaque Troia dabit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.339
passages.text: Ei mihi! pars a me vix dicitur ulla futuri.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.340
passages.text: Plura feres, quam quae littera nostra refert.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.341
passages.text: Nec tu rapta time, ne nos fera bella sequantur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.342
passages.text: Concitet et vires Graecia magna suas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.343
passages.text: Tot prius abductis ecqua est repetita per arma?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.344
passages.text: Crede mihi, vanos res habet ista metus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.345
passages.text: Nomine ceperunt Aquilonis Erechthida Thraces,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.346
passages.text: Et tuta a bello Bistonis ora fuit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.347
passages.text: Phasida puppe nova vexit Pagasaeus Iason,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.348
passages.text: Laesa neque est Colcha Thessala terra manu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.349
passages.text: Te quoque qui rapuit, rapuit Minoida Theseus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.350
passages.text: Nulla tamen Minos Cretas ad arma vocat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.351
passages.text: Terror in his ipso maior solet esse periclo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.352
passages.text: Quaeque timere licet, pertimuisse pudet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.353
passages.text: Finge tamen, si vis, ingens consurgere bellum —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.354
passages.text: Et mihi sunt vires, et mea tela nocent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.355
passages.text: Nec minor est Asiae quam vestrae copia terrae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.356
passages.text: Illa viris dives, dives abundat equis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.357
passages.text: Nec plus Atrides animi Menelaus habebit

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.358
passages.text: Quam Paris aut armis anteferendus erit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.359
passages.text: Paene puer caesis abducta armenta recepi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.360
passages.text: Hostibus et causam nominis inde tuli;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.361
passages.text: Paene puer iuvenes vario certamine vici,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.362
passages.text: In quibus Ilioneus Deiphobusque fuit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.363
passages.text: Neve putes, non me nisi comminus esse timendum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.364
passages.text: Figitur in iusso nostra sagitta loco.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.365
passages.text: Num potes haec illi primae dare facta iuventae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.366
passages.text: Instruere Atriden num potes arte mea?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.367
passages.text: Omnia si dederis, numquid dabis Hectora fratrem?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.368
passages.text: Unus is innumeri militis instar erit!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.369
passages.text: Quid valeam nescis, et te mea robora fallunt;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.370
passages.text: Ignoras, cui sis nupta futura viro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.371
passages.text: Aut igitur nullo belli repetere tumultu,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.372
passages.text: Aut cedent Marti Dorica castra meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.373
passages.text: Nec tamen indigner pro tanta sumere ferrum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.374
passages.text: Coniuge. certamen praemia magna movent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.375
passages.text: Tu quoque, si de te totus contenderit orbis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.376
passages.text: Nomen ab aeterna posteritate feres

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.377
passages.text: Spe modo non timida dis hinc egressa secundis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 16.378
passages.text: Exige cum plena munera pacta fide.
